reference_format.note: P/YY/NNNN, with an optional type suffix (e.g. P/26/0051/V). The serial is four digits.

quirks.summary: Search-result metaInfo fields are separated by U+00B7, not '|'.
quirks.workaround: Split on U+00B7, or take the reference up to the first whitespace.

quirks.summary: The council's committee-papers system was not identified in this run.
quirks.detail: Two requests to the council website (a guessed CMIS path, 404, and the home page) found no link to a committee system. Committee reports may not be on the portal's documents tab.
quirks.workaround: For a committee decision, find the committee system from the council website before recording a report as missing.

pacing.note: Seven requests at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 with no 429 or challenge.

robots.note: robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' with 'Disallow: /', so the whole host is disallowed to automated clients.
